comment: One fee structure across networks. Mainnet values take precedence where live canonical factories disagree: Sepolia FixedTermHooks is 1000 protocol fee bips while mainnet is 500. PeriodicTermHooks is not registered on the mainnet canonical factory, so its 500 bips comes from the enabled Sepolia template.

FixedTermHooks.comment: Sepolia currently uses 1000 bips; mainnet's 500 bips is authoritative.

PeriodicTermHooks.comment: No mainnet template exists; copied from the enabled Sepolia PeriodicTermHooks template.
